#### Clase `MacOS` (Línea 11)
- **Docstring:** _Platform directories for the macOS operating system.

Follows the guidance from
`Apple documentation <https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/FileManagement/Conceptual/FileSystemProgrammingGuide/MacOSXDirectories/MacOSXDirectories.html>`_.
Makes use of the `appname <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.appname>`,
`version <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.version>`,
`ensure_exists <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.ensure_exists>`._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def user_data_dir(self)` (Línea 24): :return: data directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Library/Application Support/$appname/$version``
  - `def site_data_dir(self)` (Línea 29): :return: data directory shared by users, e.g. ``/Library/Application Support/$appname/$version``.
  If we're using a Python binary managed by `Homebrew <https://brew.sh>`_, the directory
  will be under the Homebrew prefix, e.g. ``/opt/homebrew/share/$appname/$version``.
  If `multipath <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.multipath>` is enabled, and we're in Homebrew,
  the response is a multi-path string separated by ":", e.g.
  ``/opt/homebrew/share/$appname/$version:/Library/Application Support/$appname/$version``
  - `def user_config_dir(self)` (Línea 46): :return: config directory tied to the user, same as `user_data_dir`
  - `def site_config_dir(self)` (Línea 51): :return: config directory shared by the users, same as `site_data_dir`
  - `def user_cache_dir(self)` (Línea 56): :return: cache directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Library/Caches/$appname/$version``
  - `def site_cache_dir(self)` (Línea 61): :return: cache directory shared by users, e.g. ``/Library/Caches/$appname/$version``.
  If we're using a Python binary managed by `Homebrew <https://brew.sh>`_, the directory
  will be under the Homebrew prefix, e.g. ``/opt/homebrew/var/cache/$appname/$version``.
  If `multipath <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.multipath>` is enabled, and we're in Homebrew,
  the response is a multi-path string separated by ":", e.g.
  ``/opt/homebrew/var/cache/$appname/$version:/Library/Caches/$appname/$version``
  - `def user_state_dir(self)` (Línea 78): :return: state directory tied to the user, same as `user_data_dir`
  - `def user_log_dir(self)` (Línea 83): :return: log directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Library/Logs/$appname/$version``
  - `def user_documents_dir(self)` (Línea 88): :return: documents directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Documents``
  - `def user_downloads_dir(self)` (Línea 93): :return: downloads directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Downloads``
  - `def user_pictures_dir(self)` (Línea 98): :return: pictures directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Pictures``
  - `def user_videos_dir(self)` (Línea 103): :return: videos directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Movies``
  - `def user_music_dir(self)` (Línea 108): :return: music directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Music``
  - `def user_desktop_dir(self)` (Línea 113): :return: desktop directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Desktop``
  - `def user_runtime_dir(self)` (Línea 118): :return: runtime directory tied to the user, e.g. ``~/Library/Caches/TemporaryItems/$appname/$version``
  - `def site_runtime_dir(self)` (Línea 123): :return: runtime directory shared by users, same as `user_runtime_dir`
